subject: Request: community support credits for OpenInfra maintainers (CodeSprint 2026)
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@openinfra.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: maintainers@openinfra.org
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Redwood credits for OpenInfra maintainers / CodeSprint booth

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — I’m Alex, community lead at OpenInfra. We run an annual maintainer support program and are scaling up support for the upcoming CodeSprint hack days (June 2026). Several of our core maintainers run demos and workshops that rely on hosted inference for quick prototyping.

A few asks:
- Could Redwood provide promotional credits for 12 maintainers (est. 3k tokens/month each for two months)?
- Can we extend trial windows for invited maintainers who have already exhausted credits?
- Do you need an org-level PO or a simple signed memo to approve?

I attached a short request summary and a CSV of the maintainer roster. We’d love to list Redwood as a sponsor on the CodeSprint site and link to your docs.

Attachments: OpenInfra_credit_request.pdf, OpenInfra_maintainer_roster.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that’s easier.

Alex Morgan
Community Lead, OpenInfra
alex@openinfra.org | +1 415 555 0198
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@openinfra.org>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood credits for OpenInfra maintainers / CodeSprint booth

Alex — thanks for the note and for including the roster. I’ve reviewed the PDF quickly and it looks like a solid program. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I route for approval: 

1) Can you confirm the total credit amount you’re requesting (token-equivalent or USD)? The PDF mentions an estimate but not a firm total.
2) Are these maintainers employees/contractors of OpenInfra or independent contributors (for tax/procurement reasons)?
3) Do you have preferred attribution wording for Redwood on the CodeSprint site (we have specific guidelines for using our logo)?

Looping in Jordan (partner ops) so we can fast-track — Jordan, can you weigh in on credit size and whether a short memo is sufficient vs a PO? Marissa, I may pull you in for comms once we have approval.

If handy, we can do a 15-min sync next week.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 2233
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex@openinfra.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood credits for OpenInfra maintainers / CodeSprint booth

Thanks Neha — Jordan here. Quick read: 12 maintainers * 3k tokens/month * 2 months — ballpark looks like approx 72k tokens. Finance typically maps that to a USD promo credit; can we convert to a one-line USD amount (helps for bookkeeping).

Preliminary position: fine to approve as a community sponsorship (no PO required) provided:
- Maintainers are named and we have an org attest/point of contact (Alex provided roster).
- Credits are time-boxed (we’ll set expiry 60 days after issuance).

Marissa — can you confirm any logo / comms constraints and whether we want to request a short case study after the event?

Alex — if you can confirm the USD equivalent and reply with a one-paragraph attestation that the maintainers are independent community contributors (not Redwood customers), we’ll issue the credits and share redemption instructions.

-Jordan
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex@openinfra.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: maintainers@openinfra.org
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood credits for OpenInfra maintainers / CodeSprint booth

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirmations below: 

- USD equivalent: request $1,800 total (covers token usage across 12 maintainers for two months; happy to provide usage estimate breakout if needed).
- Attestation: these are independent open-source maintainers affiliated with OpenInfra projects; they are not Redwood customers and are not on contractor payroll.
- Attribution: please use "Redwood Inference — community sponsor" and the small horizontal logo attached. We can send final copy for the site if you like.

Attaching a signed one-page memo from OpenInfra leadership for record.

Attachments: OpenInfra_credit_request.pdf (signed), OpenInfra_maintainer_roster.csv

If that all looks good I can confirm the list of GitHub handles for us to create redemption invites.

Cheers,
Alex
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@openinfra.org>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood credits for OpenInfra maintainers / CodeSprint booth

Alex — appreciate the attestation and the signed memo. We’re good to move forward. Final notes / next steps: 

- Approved credit amount: $1,800 in promotional credits tied to the OpenInfra maintainer roster. Credits will be issued as time-boxed promo codes, expiry 60 days from issuance.
- Redemption: please send the list of GitHub handles (or emails) for each maintainer to credits@redwood.ai. We’ll create individual redemption invites and send instructions.
- Comms: Marissa, can you please share our logo usage guidelines and a short template blurb for CodeSprint?
- Documentation & tracking: I created a HubSpot record (HS-9876123) and uploaded the signed memo to Drive (link below). For auditing, we’ll attach the approval memo to the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: approval_memo_neha_20260512.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/records/HS-9876123, https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOpenInfraDocs

Alex — once you send the maintainer emails/handles, we’ll issue codes within 48 business hours. Thanks and excited to support the community!

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 2233
